name: Moribe Chikage
source: A sophomore girl who is part of the Tower of Destiny. She belongs to the Star Festival's Executive Committee, and is always hiding her true face behind a mask; she never has to take the mask off, as she can eat, speak and drink with it on. Though Chikage is mysterious, she is like a normal girl and has a "normal girl's hobbies": she likes eating marshmallows and loves cats. Only Kuu and Kotone have seen her face; Kotone says that she has a very cute face.
